A new group of major firms, the Open Secure AI Alliance, are setting out to build open-source AI tools for security defences. Nvidia, Adobe, Cisco, Cloudflare, CrowdStrike, IBM, Microsoft, Palo Alto Networks, Red Hat, Salesforce, SAP, and ServiceNow sit alongside cloud and infrastructure providers such as Dell Technologies, HPE, NetApp, and Snowflake.
